business-dragon:
Create a production game sprite sheet on a truly transparent background: TWO equal square cells in ONE horizontal row, exactly two full-body drawings, no text, boxes, furniture, props or ground shadows. Image 1 is the approved character identity and pixel-art style reference. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for couch camera and seated posture. Preserve the character's exact outfit, colors, face shape, ears, tail and crisp shaded pixel style. Both cells show the character SITTING relaxed on an invisible couch, viewed from the same elevated three-quarter camera as image 2, facing toward lower LEFT / southwest, with their back parallel to the couch back. Hips and buttocks bear weight on an imaginary horizontal cushion, thighs project forward toward lower left nearly horizontal, knees bent at 90 degrees, lower legs drop down, both shoes resting on the floor. Torso upright with slight comfortable recline, hands relaxed on thighs. An anatomically credible adult seated pose, not a squat, kneel, standing, floating or tiny child. Keep head size and body proportions of image 1. Tail rests beside and behind the hip without crossing shoes. Frame 1 eyes open, frame 2 same seated pose with eyes briefly closed for a blink. Identical silhouette/body geometry, hip contact, clothing and size in both frames except eyelids, no changes in perspective. Generous transparent margins per cell. Character fully visible including tail and shoes. Do not draw any couch or chair from the second reference.
Character: red dragon wearing navy suit jacket, ivory shirt, red tie, charcoal trousers and black shoes.
